(Nasdaq: WTBA) (the “Company”), parent company of West Bank, will report its results for the second quarter of 2026 on Thursday, July 23, 2026 before the markets open. The Company will discuss its results in a conference call scheduled for 2:00 p.m. Central Time on Thursday, July 23, 2026. The telephone number for the conference call is 800-715-9871. The conference ID for the conference call is 7846129. A recording of the call will be available until August 6, 2026, by dialing 800-770-2030. The conference ID for the replay call is 7846129, followed by the # key. West Bancorporation, Inc. is headquartered in West Des Moines, Iowa.
